name: Caretaker Drone's [Class Bonus] On Death: Glimpse 4
notes: Caretaker Drone is NORM (no lineage patch needed). Its [Class Bonus] On Death is coded as IsClassBonusActive($player) with NO class argument (GameLogic.php's IsClassBonusActive treats a null $classes as 'any champion present,' GameLogic.php ~18079-18104), so it fires unconditionally as long as a champion exists -- no champion patch needed at all. Only Intercept (a shared static ability tested elsewhere) is out of scope. Undeniable Truth's own 'mandatory sacrifice of an ally' additional cost (GameLogic.php's DoActivateCard cost-declaration switch, $hasUndeniableTruthCost) is borrowed to kill Caretaker Drone via a non-combat removal path (same technique as crest-of-the-alliance-fostered-ally-dies-draw), which triggers On Death reliably and surfaces the resulting Glimpse-4 MZREARRANGE decision (resolved keeping original order) earlier in the action sequence than the reserve payment -- the whole chain still resolves cleanly to an empty decision queue with Caretaker Drone confirmed in the graveyard.
